content.text: What does a game of Whisperspace look like? How can you plan a long-form campaign in this setting? A one-shot? Here you will find recommendations and tools for Game Masters looking to run Whisperspace games. Nothing here is set in stone; everything here is meant as advice or to be helpful. If you think the game runs better for your table when you alter these ideas or ignore them entirely, please do that.

As the Game Master, it is your responsibility to tailor the world of Whisperspace as well as the rules themselves to create as entertaining an experience for your players as you can. To that end, this section contains tables to generate random encounters, stat blocks for various NPCs, villains, and monsters for you to challenge your players with, and an introductory adventure you can open up and run as-is or modified however you wish. Ready? Good. Let’s dive in.
